_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor from GoatCounter's documentation; no upstream egg.
name: GoatCounter
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: GoatCounter is simple, privacy-friendly web analytics without tracking cookies. The egg runs it with SQLite: open its address once to create your site and the admin account.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GoatCounter: downloads GoatCounter from its GitHub releases, checked
# against GitHub's SHA-256. The database (goatcounter-data) is never
# touched, and the binary is only replaced once the new one is complete.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "GoatCounter has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag arp242/goatcounter "$version") || exit 1

if [ -x goatcounter ] && [ "$(cat .goatcounter-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "GoatCounter $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading GoatCounter $tag"
    gh-release download arp242/goatcounter "$tag" "goatcounter-$tag-linux-$arch.gz" "$work/goatcounter.gz"
    gzip -dc "$work/goatcounter.gz" > "$work/goatcounter"
    install -m 0755 "$work/goatcounter" goatcounter.new
    mv -f goatcounter.new goatcounter
    echo "$tag" > .goatcounter-version
fi
mkdir -p goatcounter-data
echo "Installed GoatCounter $tag. Open the server's address to create your site and account."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The GoatCounter version to install, a 2.x release such as 2.7.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Extra flags
variables.description: More flags for goatcounter serve, such as -smtp smtp://user:pass@host:587 to send emails.
